title: Effective Approaches to Attention-based Neural Machine Translation
authors: M. Luong, H. Pham, C. Manning
before: One formulation of attention existed, using a small feed-forward scoring network.
problem: That scoring step was expensive and its design choices untested.
breakthrough: Simpler multiplicative scoring, plus global and local attention variants, compared systematically.
why: The dot-product scoring the Transformer uses comes from this line of simplification.
next: Scaled dot-product attention in the Transformer.
inherits: Dot-product similarity as the scoring function inside attention.
